name: Pull-down kitchen faucet
notes: Rig: lever hinge Z 0...60; spout swivel Y -90...90; head slide down along spout 0...0.2 (mimic none). Option: water stream column (water.stream) on when lever > 10. States: off, on, swung-left, pulled-out.
summary: Pull-down kitchen faucet: high-arc gooseneck spout, spray head, side lever, deck plate; lever opens a water stream.
